no_adcom_quote.quote: The Agency conducted no Advisory Committee Meeting regarding this application because there were no major safety issues and the adverse event profile was expected to be similar to other topical retinoids.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the AKLIEF (trifarotene) NDA. The Multidiscipline Review's Section 9 explicitly states the Agency held no AdComm because there were no major safety issues and the adverse event profile was expected to be similar to other topical retinoids. With no committee, there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
